import { publishFromCandidate, requireCron, response, runEnd, runStart } from "../_shared/greener.ts";
Deno.serve(async (req) => { const denied = requireCron(req); if (denied) return denied; const id = await runStart("greener-breaking-news"); try { const r = await publishFromCandidate("greener-breaking-news", true); await runEnd(id, r.published ? "success" : "skipped", { created: r.published ? 1 : 0, skipped: r.published ? 0 : 1 }, undefined, r); return response(r); } catch (e) { await runEnd(id, "failed", {}, e); return response({ error: "breaking scan failed" }, 500); } });
